subject: Dynamic submodular maximization — kickoff
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kickoff for dynamic submodular maximization. Our open-source release implements fully dynamic algorithms for constrained submodular optimization with oracle access — the reference setting is graph coverage and influence maximization, which maps directly onto candidate selection freshness in the retrieval stack: we want the selected set to stay near-optimal as the underlying graph gets edge insertions and deletions, without recomputing from scratch.

Milestones: replicate the paper's experiments by Apr 24, port the oracle to our internal graph by Jun 5, freshness A/B design ready ahead of Q3 OKRs.

Giannis, Csilla and Bilal are assigned; Csilla is our submodularity depth. Staffing and compute over to you.

Anders
